description: This file handles delivery dispatching for cron jobs within the openclaw project, including message delivery, error handling, retries, and session management.

methods.name: normalizeDeliveryTarget
methods.description: Normalizes the delivery target string based on channel and recipient, trimming and applying provider normalization.

methods.name: matchesMessagingToolDeliveryTarget
methods.description: Checks if a delivery target matches a messaging tool delivery configuration, considering provider, target, and account ID.

methods.name: resolveCronDeliveryBestEffort
methods.description: Determines if a cron job's delivery is configured for best effort.

methods.name: cloneDeliveryResults
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of delivery result objects, including nested meta data.

methods.name: pruneCompletedDirectCronDeliveries
methods.description: Removes old completed delivery entries from cache based on TTL and maximum size.

methods.name: resolveCronDeliveryScheduledAtMs
methods.description: Resolves the scheduled start time of a cron delivery, defaulting to run start time if not set.

methods.name: resolveCronDeliveryStartDelayMs
methods.description: Calculates delay between run start and scheduled start time.

methods.name: isStaleCronDelivery
methods.description: Checks if a cron delivery is considered stale based on delay threshold.

methods.name: rememberCompletedDirectCronDelivery
methods.description: Caches the results of a successful direct cron delivery with timestamp.

methods.name: getCompletedDirectCronDelivery
methods.description: Retrieves cached delivery results for a given delivery key.

methods.name: buildDirectCronDeliveryIdempotencyKey
methods.description: Constructs a unique key for idempotent delivery based on session, target, and thread.

methods.name: shouldQueueCronAwareness
methods.description: Determines if a cron job should enqueue awareness events based on session scope and delivery mode.

methods.name: resolveCronAwarenessMainSessionKey
methods.description: Resolves the main session key for cron awareness events based on configuration scope.

methods.name: queueCronAwarenessSystemEvent
methods.description: Enqueues a system event for cron awareness, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: summarizeDirectCronDeliveryError
methods.description: Converts an error object into a string message for logging or analysis.

methods.name: isTransientDirectCronDeliveryError
methods.description: Checks if an error matches transient error patterns for retries.

methods.name: resolveDirectCronRetryDelaysMs
methods.description: Provides retry delay intervals, varying for test environment.

methods.name: retryTransientDirectCronDelivery
methods.description: Retries a transient delivery operation with exponential backoff based on error patterns.

methods.name: dispatchCronDelivery
methods.description: Main function to handle delivery of cron job outputs, including error handling, retries, session cleanup, and notification.
